DSPSC.description: PSC Design Code (DSPSC). The only field is the design code name; writes accept the AASHTO LRFD family only (National Annex is forced to Amend_Recommended; the LRFD17 Amendment is chosen via DPSC instead).

DGNCODE.description: Design code name. OnSet accepts only the AASHTO LRFD family listed here (any other code is rejected with LV_WRONG_FIELD); GET is unrestricted and may return a non-AASHTO code set through the UI.
